g.text: Nothing here is optional and the order matters: each step's checks
depend on the previous step's output existing.
Step 2 is the whole of what is applied by hand.
Everything after it is rendered, and the CRDs it
pins are the only cluster-scoped schema the model
the capability list validates against the node contract
the CRDs must exist before any object of their kind
every placement dimension is matched against
existing PV bindings and the disk dimension read the
